text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The United States is aware of a United Arab Emirates arms package for the Moslem-Croat federation, including 36 150 mm cannons, the daily quotes a State Department spokesman as saying.
- The European Union has provided 3.5 million German marks for the construction of a new health care centre, due to start on Thursday in divided southern Bosnian city of Mostar.
- Session of the newly created Bosnian parliament, due on December 7, will be held in the Sarajevo's National Theater since repair of the war shattered parliament building has not been finished yet.
- Stability of the Moslem-Croat federation is essential for the stability of Croatia, Croatian ambassador to Bosnia, Darinko Bago, says in an interview published on Thursday.
